subject.title: [Refactor] Extract canonical configuration validation from core to plugin boundaries

question: Does current main contain a specific plugin-owned configuration schema that still must move out of core, or should the existing manifest-first `configSchema` and `channelConfigs` contract be considered the completed architecture?
rationale: The general architectural goal is already documented and implemented, while the issue names no remaining schema and proposes a boot-time runtime-composition mechanism that conflicts with the established cold-path contract.

options.title: Require a concrete residual
options.body: Keep the issue open only if a maintainer names the exact remaining core schema and expected owner-boundary change.

options.title: Close as complete
options.body: Treat manifest-owned `configSchema` and `channelConfigs` as satisfying the request and close unless a concrete regression is reported.

options.title: Redesign validation boot
options.body: Sponsor runtime plugin interrogation and define its startup, security, failure, and compatibility contract before implementation.

recommendation.title: Require a concrete residual
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open only if a maintainer names the exact remaining core schema and expected owner-boundary change.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository vision and recent plugin-boundary history make this the strongest available owner for the architecture choice.
